title: System Overview and Microservice Orchestration
description: Start here to understand how Docker Compose orchestrates the companion microservices (MAVLink router, camera streaming, vision, CC agent, MAVROS) with network_mode: host on Raspberry Pi 5.

title: Hardware Discovery and Autopilot Serial Probing
description: Examine how the hardware manager automatically detects Flight Controller serial UART devices (/dev/ttyAMA4, /dev/ttyUSB*) and monitors USB peripheral health.

title: MAVLink Packet Routing Architecture
description: Inspect the low-latency MAVLink routing subsystem that bridges the autopilot serial stream to internal companion processes and external GCS telemetry endpoints.

title: Companion Computer Agent and Custom Dialect
description: Dive into the central CC agent managing dynamic parameter persistence, health states, and the THACO custom MAVLink protocol extensions.

title: Camera Pipeline and Low-Latency Video Streaming
description: Follow video ingestion from V4L2/RealSense cameras through ARM NEON SIMD color conversion and lock-free ring buffers to GStreamer RTSP streaming.

title: YOLO Computer Vision and Target Localization
description: Understand the computer vision pipeline that runs real-time object detection and transforms 2D bounding boxes into 3D world target coordinates.

title: ROS 2 MAVROS Plugins and Deployment Automation
description: Review ROS 2 Jazzy integration via custom MAVROS plugins and the scripts powering cross-compilation and automated deployment to Raspberry Pi 5.
